cab_non_reserve_daily.label: cab_non_reserve_daily

required_reserves_daily_avg.source_id: label:Required reserves for the current maintenance period

cab_net_change_daily.label: cab_net_change_daily

ops_subtotal_daily.label: Market operations net (excl. Loan Support Program)

pooled_collateral_ops_daily.label: pooled_collateral_ops_daily
pooled_collateral_ops_daily.equivalence_note: repo-like funds supply; nimble response tool for rapid yield rises

clf_loans_daily.label: Complementary Lending Facility usage (penalty rate = basic loan rate)

slf_daily.source_id: label:Securities lending as a secondary source of JGSs
slf_daily.label: Securities Lending Facility (JGB lending) net
slf_daily.equivalence_note: JGB collateral scarcity gauge (used operationally too → percentile, not > 0)

boj_loans.source_id: Loans (excluding those to the Deposit Insurance Corporation)
boj_loans.label: boj_loans

loan_support_program.source_id: Annex 2: Fund-Provisioning Measure to Stimulate Bank Lending
loan_support_program.label: loan_support_program

pooled_collateral_loans.source_id: Annex 3: Loans by Funds-Supplying Operations against Pooled Collateral (+disaster +climate)
pooled_collateral_loans.label: pooled_collateral_loans

current_deposits.label: current_deposits
current_deposits.equivalence_note: cross-check of cab_daily on the same date

monthly_fiscal_breakdown.label: monthly_fiscal_breakdown
monthly_fiscal_breakdown.equivalence_note: attribution of monthly CAB changes; MASDM26 = FX (FEFSA settlement of MoF intervention shows here)

cab_by_sector.label: cab_by_sector
cab_by_sector.equivalence_note: distribution of excess reserves; foreign banks' share is the funding canary (Gemini/Perplexity/CodeWord)

excess_over_required_daily.label: Excess reserves = reserve balances − required (daily avg)
excess_over_required_daily.equivalence_note: desk definition; the BoJ row 'Excess reserves' is period-based

excess_to_required_ratio.label: Excess / required reserves (ampleness multiple)
excess_to_required_ratio.equivalence_note: ampleness multiple; 28.5x on 2026-09-07 — dead-man switch only, never a scoring driver

reconciliation_cab.label: Δ CAB vs reported net change (100m yen)

net_liquidity.label: Balance-sheet liquidity = Total assets − Government deposits (ten-day)
net_liquidity.equivalence_note: kept as the cross-currency analogue; the primary JPY reserves gauge is cab_daily / excess_reserves_daily

net_liquidity_change_pct.label: Balance-sheet liquidity Δ% per ten-day step

jgb_purchases_month_to_date.label: Outright JGB purchases in the month judged (100m yen)
jgb_purchases_month_to_date.note: policy-driven QT pace: compare with calendar.jgb_purchase_plan

jgb_purchases_vs_plan_pct.label: JGB purchases (projected month) vs plan
jgb_purchases_vs_plan_pct.note: projected = month-to-date scaled by business days; > +20% = nimble support (yield spike), < −20% = faster QT than announced

holdings_vs_expected_path.label: JGB holdings − expected path (519.9 tn → ~480 tn by 2027-03-31)
holdings_vs_expected_path.note: INFORMATIONAL: run-off is mechanical (redemption calendar); not a policy flag (CodeWord)

jgb_holdings_90d_change.label: JGB holdings Δ over 9 ten-day steps (~quarter; redemptions cluster on the 20th of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec)

boj_credit_dependence.label: BoJ credit share of current deposits (pooled collateral + Loan Support Program)
boj_credit_dependence.equivalence_note: share of reserves supplied by BoJ lending vs outright holdings — analogue of repo_dependence_ratio; 17% on 2026-08-31

currency_drain_daily.label: Banknote factor (BoJ sign: minus = net issuance = drain)

balance_sheet_phase.label: Balance-sheet phase
balance_sheet_phase.note: NIMBLE_SUPPORT if jgb_purchases_vs_plan_pct > +20% or pooled_collateral_ops rising with jgb_10y_5d_change ≥ WATCH; QT if purchases within ±20% of plan and holdings falling; STEADY otherwise
